label: copy phase, mid/late recall, fed-back input z/n/g/e/3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, from recall_idx 2 onward (never in the original phase, on <DEL>, or for the first two outputs). All active steps are repeat occurrences of the input token. Rate is strongly token-dependent on the fed-back input: z (8.7x lift, 34% of mass), then n, g, e, 3, and weaker o, j, x. It is also strongly position-dependent: it peaks at t=12 (recall_idx 3, mostly L=9; 41% of mass) and is concentrated in long sequences (L=9 holds 60% of mass). The strongest activations are z input at recall_idx 3 in L=9 sequences (precision 0.82 for that narrow case, though it covers only 7% of mass). The token-set predicate captures 79% of activation mass but precision is only about 0.13, because most steps with these tokens at these positions stay inactive. Adding L>=8 raises dev F1 to 0.28 at the cost of mass recall (0.63). What decides firing beyond token and position is not captured; it may depend on hidden state from the specific prefix.
